name: Szirmabesenyő (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szirmabesenyő (a red and blue shield with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling) above the name SZIRMABESENYŐ in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
